summary: Run locked all-500-feature RF (mf=1.0, msl=2, 2000 trees): 3x5 pilot CV then one heldout scoring
reasoning: Executing the pre-registered fallback of step-22: since randomized forests did not beat the fixed config (paired diff -0.0002), the locked learner is the pilot-CV ceiling config (gini, max_features=1.0, min_samples_leaf=2), chosen by 46 pilot CV folds across three searches - pilot-only knowledge, no heldout signal involved. The final analysis.py now triggers no tuning: cv_auc is repeated 3x5 CV of the identical deployed forest (T=2000), holdout is scored once by the forest trained on all pilot rows. Building on step-7 of probe:madelon-2026-11-15-2 (established: inherited analysis misses the floor). Based on that step, sibling sealed routes' cv-to-holdout shift of about -0.04, and my own honest tuned run (cv 0.718 / holdout 0.694), I expect holdout_auc 0.69-0.72 - plausibly just below the 0.71 floor - and |gap| <= 0.05 (the estimate should agree once tuning noise is out). Heldout is scored exactly once by this run and never again.
